verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several public HTTP API surfaces: the Events API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, Platform API audience endpoints, the Warehouse Sync API, and the versioned Data Subject Request API v3. Together these let a programmatic or AI-driven consumer drive core ingestion, audience, warehouse-sync and privacy workflows. Missing for 10: machine-readable specs for the Platform and Profile APIs (the spec covers the Events API only), detailed evidence of how far the Platform API covers configuration and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
